subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open conflicting fork PR for this Debug Snapshots fix, or close/supersede that path and allow a fresh narrow fix from this issue?
rationale: The source bug and fix shape are clear, but an open fork PR with closing syntax already exists and automation should not queue a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the implementation path.

options.title: Supersede the fork path
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Debug page structure with localized copy, focused tests, and proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch, move the change to the current files, add tests/proof, and review it as the implementation path.

recommendation.title: Supersede the fork path
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Debug page structure with localized copy, focused tests, and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest historical ownership signal for the Debug page wiring and can decide whether to adopt or supersede the fork path.
